title: Round changes
description: What the agent changed in a round, `rounds/<N>/changes.json` beside that round's screenshots, so a person sees each change next to the feedback it answers. The prototype viewer marks a feedback item done once a later round answers it, and `aidd explore` lists each change beside its screen. `aidd validate` checks each file against this schema.

changes.description: The changes made in this round.

summary.description: What changed, in a sentence a person reads beside the screenshot.

answers.description: The ids of the feedback items this change answers, from an earlier `feedback-round-<N>.json`.

screen.description: The screen the change shows on, by its `data-screen` id, so the page puts it beside that screenshot.

state.description: The state, by its `data-state` name, with the screen.
